title: Validate business rules and isolate users
prompt: A checkout accepts client prices and reads another user’s order by ID. Explain how the backend should validate the request and how to verify database row-level access. Respond in a few concise lines; do not modify files.
rubric: The answer derives prices and rules from trusted server data and validates quantity.
It authenticates and authorizes each resource and tests access between two users.
It verifies row-level policies with the actual application role, including bypass or owner privileges.
acceptance: The response satisfies the listed behavioral requirements and makes no changes.
